title: COLREG lights and shapes — Rules 21-31
source: Convention on the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1972 (COLREG 72), as amended, Part C (Lights and Shapes) and Annex I (Positioning and technical details of lights and shapes).
status: STEP 1 placeholder — the full dataset is delivered in STEP 4.

_entryShape.name: Display name, e.g. Power-driven vessel underway, less than 50 m
_entryShape.category: power | towing | sailing | fishing | restricted | pilot | anchored | aground

lights.arcCentre: relative bearing of the arc centre, 0 = right ahead
lights.position: Annex I positioning note, e.g. forward masthead, 6 m above the hull

dayShapes.arrangement: vertical line | apexes together | where best seen

commonConfusions: ids of entries learners mix this one up with
